Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that child protective service workers be licensed as social workers and bonded.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child protective services workers; and adding anew section to chapter 26.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any child protective services worker who is directly engaged in: (1) Investigation of reports of alleged child abuse or neglect, (2) Assessment of risk of abuse or neglect to children, or (3) Provision of and/or referral to services, including lawenforcement, to remedy conditions that endanger the health, safety, andwelfare of children,must be licensed in good standing in a social work classification underchapter 18.225 RCW, and bonded.
